title: Artwork catalogue entry
description: Fields a future import script will use. artwork/catalogue.json (466 entries, gitignored) is the current on-disk index and still uses dest, category, filename, source, thumb, and site_matches. Do not rewrite those source paths until files actually move. masterPath is a planned location, not a claim the file is already there. status is planned until a later stage copies pixels.

category.description: Japanese, international, and Victorian characters stay identifiable by category even when their transparent PNG masters share artwork/characters/transparent/. The 19 transparent Japanese animal heroes are character-japanese. International transparent heroes are character-international. The Victorian animal heroes set is character-victorian. Turbo the mascot is character-turbo. The 33 japaneseheroes.png historical illustrations are puzzle-historical-japanese (puzzle images, not the 19 collectible heroes). character-historical-japanese is reserved if a later set is a character rather than a full illustration.

masterPath.description: Planned path under artwork/. Examples: artwork/characters/transparent/<file>, artwork/characters/ivory/<file>, artwork/backgrounds/<file>, artwork/puzzles/<file>, artwork/castles/<file>, artwork/pins/<file>. Not a claim the file is there yet while status is planned.

sourcePath.description: Absolute path where the file lives today. Leave unchanged until the file is moved.

sitePath.description: Public web path under site/, or null when the website does not show this file.

status.description: planned means the masterPath is a target only. present means the file is at masterPath.

folders.artwork/characters/transparent/: Any character PNG (Japanese, international, Victorian, Turbo). Category distinguishes the set.
folders.artwork/characters/ivory/: Character JPEGs on an ivory ground.
folders.artwork/puzzles/: Puzzle images, including the 33 Japanese historical illustrations.
